text:
Sam Park: FYI bringing up `xai-3-small` from HF. Conversion kicked out a model that generates empty system messages in chat mode. looks like tokenizer mismatch. :eyes:
Maria Chen: can you paste the files you got from HF? fast vs slow tokenizer usually bites us here.
Sam Park: sure, quick dump:
```
ls -1 converted_model/
- config.json
- tokenizer.json
- tokenizer_config.json
- merges.txt
- vocab.json
- special_tokens_map.json (MISSING)
```
Sam Park: tokenizer_config.json references `slow_tokenizer_class: "PreTrainedTokenizer"` and points to `vocab_file: vocab.txt` (file not present). tokenizer.json exists (the fast tokenizer) and contains `added_tokens` with our role markers `<|system|>`, but no special_tokens_map.
Alex Ruiz: that explains KeyError when chat template tries to insert `bos_token`/`eos_token`. Fast tokenizer expects merges/vocab shapes; slow config expects a different set. Repro log:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve.py", line 42, in <module>
    tokenizer.bos_token
KeyError: 'bos_token'
```
Maria Chen: were there any HF conversion warnings? sometimes `transformers` saves tokenizer.json only and not tokenizer_config.json properly if `save_pretrained` was used weirdly.
Sam Park: yes this line in our convert log: `WARNING: tokenizer_config.json missing special_tokens_map -> defaulting to slow tokenizer config`
infra-bot: conversion-job-392 queued. status: failed -> queued for retry.
Alex Ruiz: quick triage: two common ways to fix -> 1) prefer fast tokenizer (use tokenizer.json) and synthesize tokenizer_config.json with fields copied from tokenizer.json (added tokens -> special_tokens_map, set bos/eos), or 2) load HF tokenizer with use_fast=False to force slow and ensure vocab/merges exist. Option 1 is less disruptive.
Joel Turner: I'm +1 on Option 1, but add a deterministic test so we don't regress. Maybe a unit that loads converted artifact and verifies all special tokens referenced in chat templates exist as tokenizer.token_to_id.
Maria Chen: here's a tiny patch I ran locally that merges tokens into tokenizer_config.json and sets `tokenizer_class` to the fast class we detected:
```
# naive merge
import json
with open('tokenizer.json') as f: tokf=json.load(f)
conf={}
try:
  with open('tokenizer_config.json') as g: conf=json.load(g)
except FileNotFoundError:
  conf={}
special = tokf.get('added_tokens', [])
conf.setdefault('special_tokens_map', {})
for t in special:
  name = t.get('single_word', t.get('content', None)) or t.get('token', None)
  if name:
    conf['special_tokens_map'][name] = name
conf['tokenizer_class'] = 'FastTokenizer'
with open('tokenizer_config.json','w') as h: json.dump(conf, h)
```
Maria Chen: worked for me in local serve - chat templates now render system/assistant tokens. :+1:
Sam Park: thanks. two follow-ups: 1) add a conversion-stage heuristic to prefer tokenizer.json if tokenizer_config.json points to missing files. 2) add eval: rerun a small chat-quality regression test (our 20-prompt smoke) and quantization pass to ensure no token id drift.
Alex Ruiz: I'll own (1). Will send a PR to onboarding-converters and include a small script to merge special tokens.
Joel Turner: I'll add the smoke regression and a token-id check to the onboarding CI. If token ids change after quantization we should block.
Sam Park: timeline?
Alex Ruiz: PR today, tests tomorrow, patch rollout to staging on Friday.
Maria Chen: also logging note: add a conversion warning that explicitly lists missing files and what auto-fix was applied. saves us chasing in support tickets.
infra-bot: deploy/pipeline: onboarding-converters PR #847 opened by AlexR. CI: pending.
Sam Park: great, thanks everyone. I'll re-run the quantized bench once PR lands and report any quality deltas.
Maria Chen: thanks — if you hit anything odd ping me or drop the converted artifact here.
Sam Park: will do.
